name: the Linux service restarts stall:watch 20 seconds after any exit, from its checkout under its PATH (#4167)
output:
[Unit]
Description=gandr stall detector (stall:watch)

[Service]
WorkingDirectory=/srv/gandr
Environment=PATH=/usr/bin:/bin
ExecStart=/usr/bin/mise run stall:watch
Restart=always
RestartSec=20

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
